name: open-card-alone
description: The open card has no card and nothing links to it.

name: outgoing-and-incoming-merge
description: 1 hop is the union of cards the open card links to (that exist) and cards linking to it. Ghost has no card, so it is not listed.

name: outgoing-and-incoming-same-card
description: A card that is both linked to and linking back is listed once.

name: page-that-does-not-exist-yet
description: The open title has no card, but other cards can already link to it. It links to nothing itself, so there is no 2 hop.

name: deleted-cards-are-excluded
description: A deleted card is never listed, whether the open card links to it or it links to the open card.

name: self-and-other-pods-are-excluded
description: Self links never list the open card. A card of another pod is not linked even when its title matches, and its own links count only inside its pod.

name: titlelc-match-is-case-insensitive
description: Links match cards by titleLc: 'foo bar' reaches 'Foo Bar', and 'FOO_BAR' shares its target. The via title keeps the open card's spelling.

name: two-hop-shared-target
description: The target X does not have to exist. Deleted cards and cards of other pods do not count as sharing it.

name: two-hop-excludes-one-hop
description: B shares X with A but is already one hop away, so only C is listed.

name: two-hop-groups-by-target
description: B shares X and Y but is listed under X only. Z has no other linker, so it has no row.

name: two-hop-first-shared-target-of-the-open-card
description: Only the open card's link order decides the group: A links Y before X, B links X before Y.

name: two-hop-title-order-is-binary
description: Cards of one group are sorted by title in byte order: uppercase before lowercase.

name: one-hop-order-is-utf8-byte-order
description: Hiragana (U+3042), fullwidth A (U+FF21) and an emoji (U+1F600) sort in UTF-8 byte order. UTF-16 order would put the emoji before the fullwidth A.

name: two-hop-order-is-utf8-byte-order
description: Same characters as above, sorted inside one 2 hop group.
